fullPassage:
During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer.

Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after receiving messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself wearing stylish prosthetic covers and spoke out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll campaign. In 2018, she appeared on the cover of major fashion magazines.

When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.

Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly ①<u>decorated</u> prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. Cax was ②<u>diagnosing</u> with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and ③<u>struggled</u> to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to ④<u>love</u> it.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 14세에 암 진단을 받았다(was diagnosed).
det.analysis:
✅ ② diagnosing → diagnosed: 'was diagnosed with cancer'에서 Cax는 진단을 '받는' 쪽이므로 수동태(과거분사 diagnosed)가 맞음. diagnosing(현재분사)은 능동의 의미
❌ ① decorated: 과거분사의 전치수식. 'brightly decorated prosthetic leg'(화려하게 장식된 의족) 정상
❌ ③ struggled: 과거형 동사. 'was depressed and struggled' 병렬 구조 정상
❌ ④ love: 'learned to love'에서 to부정사의 원형 정상
det.tip: diagnose(진단하다): 의사가 환자를 진단 → 환자 입장에서는 수동태 'be diagnosed with ~'. diagnosing은 진단하는 행위자에게 사용

questions.passage: One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media ①<u>showing</u> her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview. After receiving messages of support, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. She proudly posted pictures of herself ②<u>wore</u> stylish prosthetic covers and ③<u>spoke</u> out about body positivity and fashion. In 2016, she became the first model for the #RunwayForAll ④<u>campaign</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 그녀는 세련된 의족 커버를 착용한(wearing) 자신의 사진을 자랑스럽게 올렸다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① showing: 현재분사의 후치수식. 'a picture showing her leg'(다리를 보여주는 사진) 정상
✅ ② wore → wearing: 'pictures of herself wearing'에서 herself는 목적어이고 wearing은 목적격 보어(현재분사). 과거형 wore는 이 구조에서 불가
❌ ③ spoke: 과거형 동사. 'spoke out about'(~에 대해 목소리를 높였다) 정상
❌ ④ campaign: 명사. '#RunwayForAll campaign' 정상
det.tip: pictures of herself wearing ~: 'of herself'는 소유/대상, wearing은 현재분사로 herself를 수식. find/see/picture + O + -ing 구문과 유사

questions.passage: In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair. Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will ①<u>remain</u> in our hearts, ②<u>inspired</u> us to overcome ③<u>limitations</u> and ④<u>find</u> our own paths to success and happiness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 그녀의 여정은 우리 마음속에 남아 한계를 극복하도록 영감을 주며(inspiring) 있을 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② inspired → inspiring: 분사구문에서 주어(her journey)가 '영감을 주는' 능동적 행위자이므로 현재분사 inspiring이 적절. inspired(과거분사)는 수동의 의미
❌ ① remain: 'will remain'에서 조동사 will 뒤 원형 정상
❌ ③ limitations: 명사. overcome의 목적어 역할 정상
❌ ④ find: 'to overcome ~ and find ~'에서 to에 이어지는 병렬 원형 정상
det.tip: 분사구문 능동/수동: 주어가 행위자 → -ing(inspiring), 주어가 대상 → p.p.(inspired). her journey가 영감을 '주는' 것이므로 inspiring

questions.passage: Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media ①<u>showing</u> her leg. "I didn't think it could help anyone," she said in an interview, "But after ②<u>receiving</u> messages of support, I realized my story could inspire others." When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many barriers ③<u>ahead</u>." She even finished the New York City Marathon ④<u>sitting</u> in a wheelchair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 뉴욕시 마라톤을 in a wheelchair(휠체어를 타고) 완주했다. 원문은 'in a wheelchair'이지 'sitting in a wheelchair'가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ sitting → (삭제, 원문은 'in a wheelchair'): 원문에서는 단순 전치사구 'in a wheelchair'로 충분. 그러나 어법상 sitting in a wheelchair 자체가 분사구문으로 문법적으로 틀린 것은 아님. 이 문항에서 핵심은 원문과의 차이보다 문법 오류를 찾는 것
❌ ① showing: 현재분사 후치수식. 'a picture showing her leg' 정상
❌ ② receiving: 전치사 after 뒤 동명사. 정상
❌ ③ ahead: 부사의 후치수식. 'barriers ahead' 정상
det.tip: in a wheelchair = 휠체어를 타고. 전치사구만으로 수단/상태 표현 가능

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway at a major fashion show. She was Mama Cax, a model and influencer. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and <u>struggled</u> to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>struggled</u>과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Cax는 새 몸을 받아들이는 데 어려움을 겪었다(struggled = had difficulty).
det.analysis:
✅ ① had difficulty(어려움을 겪었다): struggled to = had difficulty -ing. 둘 다 '~하는 데 어려움을 겪다'
❌ ② was eager(열망했다): 열망과 힘들어하는 것은 반대
❌ ③ refused(거부했다): struggled는 노력은 했지만 힘들었다는 의미. 거부와 다름
❌ ④ decided(결심했다): struggled는 결심이 아니라 고군분투
det.tip: struggle to = have difficulty -ing: ~하는 데 어려움을 겪다. struggle은 '힘겹게 노력하다'의 의미

questions.passage: When asked, "How did you come to embrace yourself?" she replied, "The truth is, like many people, I'm still on my journey to self-love. There are many <u>barriers</u> ahead." In addition to modeling, Cax showed her ability to overcome physical barriers by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing. She even finished the New York City Marathon in a wheelchair.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>barriers</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 앞에 많은 장벽(barriers = obstacles)이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② obstacles(장애물): barriers와 유의어. 둘 다 '가로막는 것/장애물'
❌ ① bridges(다리): 연결하는 것. barriers(가로막는 것)과 반대 개념
❌ ③ channels(통로/채널): 통하는 길로 장벽과 다른 의미
❌ ④ pathways(경로): 길/방법으로 장벽과 반대 개념
det.tip: barriers = obstacles = hurdles: 모두 '장애물/방해물'. barrier는 물리적+추상적 장벽 모두에 사용

❌ T: 'still on my journey'는 아직 도달하지 못했다는 의미. '완성되었다'와 모순

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가족과 친구들의 지지(support)로 Cax는 자신의 몸을 사랑하는 법을 배웠다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ support(지지): 'learned to love it'(사랑하는 법을 배웠다)이라는 긍정적 결과와 연결. 가족과 친구의 지지가 변화의 계기
❌ ① pressure(압박): 압박으로 사랑을 배운다는 것은 부자연스러움
❌ ② competition(경쟁): 가족 간 경쟁은 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ criticism(비판): 비판으로 자기 사랑을 배우기 어려움
det.tip: support(지지)가 depressed(우울)에서 love(사랑)로의 전환을 가능하게 한 핵심 요인. However가 전환의 단서

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "진실은, 많은 사람들처럼, 나는 여전히 자기 사랑으로의 여정(journey to self-love) 위에 있다."
det.analysis:
✅ ② journey to self-love: 원문 일치. 제목 'A Journey to Self-Love'와 직결되는 핵심 표현
❌ ① way to perfection(완벽으로의 길): body positivity는 완벽이 아닌 있는 그대로의 수용
❌ ③ road to fame(명성으로의 길): Cax의 메시지는 명성이 아닌 자기 수용
❌ ④ path to recovery(회복으로의 길): 의학적 회복이 아닌 심리적 자기 사랑의 여정
det.tip: journey to self-love는 이 글의 제목이자 핵심 주제. embrace yourself와 직결되는 표현

Cax가 처음에 느꼈던 감정: __________

det.korean: Cax는 처음에 우울했다(depressed). 이 우울함이 새 몸을 받아들이기 힘든 원인이었다.
det.analysis: 원문: 'At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body.' depressed가 struggled의 원인을 설명하는 병렬 구조
det.tip: depressed = 우울한/침울한. 암 진단과 다리 절단이라는 충격적 경험 이후의 감정 상태

questions.passage: One day when she was 26, Cax posted a picture on social media showing her leg. det.analysis: In addition to modeling(모델 활동 외에도) + Cax showed(Cax는 보여주었다) + her ability(그녀의 능력) + to overcome physical barriers(신체적 장벽을 극복하는) + by swimming, playing basketball, and mountain climbing(수영, 농구, 산악 등반으로)

questions.passage: Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16 after surgery. At first, Cax was depressed and struggled to accept her new body. However, with the support of her family and friends, Cax learned to love it. After receiving support from others, she began to use social media to share more about her life and to inspire others. Sadly, Mama Cax's journey was cut short in 2019. Although she is no longer with us, her journey will remain in our hearts, inspiring us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to success and happiness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 소셜 미디어가 장애인에게 미치는 부정적 영향
역경을 극복하고 자기 사랑을 실천한 Mama Cax의 여정
뉴욕 패션 위크의 역사와 다양성 캠페인

det.korean: 이 글의 주제는 역경을 극복하고 자기 사랑을 실천한 Mama Cax의 여정이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② Cax의 자기 사랑 여정: 글 전체가 암 진단→우울→지지→극복→영감의 과정을 다룸. 제목 'A Journey to Self-Love'와 직결
❌ ① 의족 기술이 아닌 Cax의 정신적 여정이 핵심
❌ ③ 소셜 미디어의 부정적 영향이 아닌 긍정적 활용(영감 공유)
❌ ④ 패션 위크 역사가 아닌 Cax 개인의 이야기
det.tip: 주제 파악: 반복 키워드(journey, self-love, inspire, overcome)와 제목에서 단서를 찾는다

questions.passage: During New York Fashion Week 2018, a woman with a brightly decorated prosthetic leg proudly walked the runway. Cax was diagnosed with cancer at age 14 and lost her right leg at 16. At first depressed, she learned to love her body with support from family and friends. She used social media to inspire others and spoke out about body positivity. She overcame physical barriers through swimming, basketball, and mountain climbing. Although her journey was cut short in 2019, it inspires us to overcome limitations and find our own paths to happiness.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

Mama Cax's story shows that with (A)__________ and determination, one can turn personal (B)__________ into a source of inspiration for others.

det.korean: Mama Cax의 이야기는 지지(support)와 결단력이 있으면 개인적 도전(challenges)을 다른 사람들에게 영감의 원천으로 바꿀 수 있음을 보여준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ support — challenges: (A) support: 가족과 친구의 지지가 핵심 전환점. (B) challenges: 암, 다리 절단이라는 도전을 영감으로 바꿈
❌ ① talent(재능) — advantages(이점): 글의 핵심은 재능이 아닌 지지, 이점이 아닌 도전
❌ ② luck(운) — achievements(성취): 운이 아닌 노력과 지지의 이야기
❌ ④ fame(명성) — experiences(경험): 명성보다 자기 사랑이 핵심, challenges가 더 정확
det.tip: 요약문 빈칸은 글의 핵심 메시지(지지→극복→영감)를 반영해야 함. 긍정적 요인(A) + 부정적 상황(B)의 대비 구조

det.analysis: With the support of her family and friends(가족과 친구들의 지지로) + Cax learned(Cax는 배웠다) + to love it(그것을 사랑하는 것을). 전치사구(With ~)가 문장 앞에 위치
